key.text: I want to make a phone stand for my desk out of wood. It should hold my phone at a slight angle, fit in my hand, and I only need one.

output.summary: The student wants to make a small wooden phone stand for a desk.

needs.why: To cut and shape wood for the phone stand

ways_considered.process: Cut wood using power tools and hand tools
ways_considered.reason: Has power tools and hand tools suitable for woodworking

ways_considered.process: Cut and shape wood in the machine shop

ways_considered.reason: Has woodworking machinery including a table saw

ways_considered.process: Cut and shape wood in the shared woodshop
ways_considered.reason: Has saws and sanders for woodworking

routes.process: Cut and sand wood pieces using power tools
routes.fit_reason: This route provides access to power tools for shaping wood. It is well-suited for a beginner who takes the required training.

steps.title: Design the piece
steps.detail: Sketch your phone stand and check its sizes to ensure it fits your phone and hand.

steps.title: Take the training
steps.detail: Take the Level 1 orientation and safety training, then complete the power tools training.

steps.title: Ask staff to check the file
steps.detail: Ask the space staff to review your measurements and design before you cut.

steps.title: Assemble and finish
steps.detail: Bring your own wood, cut the pieces with the power tools, and assemble your stand.

warnings.issue: Wood pieces may be cut too thin to support the weight of a phone.
warnings.fix: Make the base and support back thick enough to remain sturdy.

routes.process: Cut and shape wood using the shared woodshop
routes.fit_reason: The shared woodshop offers multiple saws and sanders for woodworking. Staff are available to assist you at the tool crib.

steps.title: Design the piece
steps.detail: Draw a simple plan for your phone stand with dimensions that fit your hand.

steps.title: Ask staff to check the file
steps.detail: Ask at the tool crib for guidance on how to use the woodshop safely as a beginner.

steps.title: Assemble and finish
steps.detail: Bring your own wood, use the woodshop saws and sanders, and glue your pieces together.

warnings.issue: Using saws without experience can lead to uneven cuts.
warnings.fix: Ask staff at the tool crib for help before making your cuts.

routes.fit_reason: Iovine and Young Hall includes woodworking machinery suited for cutting desk accessories. Contact the academy first to verify access.

steps.title: Design the piece
steps.detail: Plan out the dimensions for your phone stand on paper.

steps.title: Ask staff to check the file
steps.detail: Contact the academy at iovine-young@usc.edu to ask who may use the maker spaces and how.

steps.title: Assemble and finish
steps.detail: Bring your own wood, cut your parts using the woodworking machinery, and assemble the stand.

warnings.issue: The official page does not list hours or access rules for students.
warnings.fix: Email the academy staff to confirm when you can use the equipment.
